risks: Total coverage meets the 85% gate exactly; Review must prioritize the directly tested financial, callback, isolation, idempotency, and concurrency paths rather than rely only on the aggregate percentage.
The callback rate limiter depends on Redis and intentionally fails closed when cache is unavailable; operational alerting belongs to homologation.
Pagar.me callback authenticity remains unresolved and is therefore blocked in both application and database contracts.
No sandbox evidence exists because external calls were explicitly outside the approved implementation checkpoint.
